edges.reason: Constructor writes the initial balance of the deployer into _balances.
Constructor reads _tTotal as the initial minted amount.
User-supplied pair address is written directly to _tUniswapPair by an owner-only setter.
User-supplied blacklist address is written directly to _tBlackAddress by an owner-only setter.
Mint amount parameter feeds the supply and balance arithmetic in setFeeTotal.
Percent parameter is multiplied and stored into _maxWallet.
Spender argument flows into allowance bookkeeping through approve.
Owner and spender parameters index the _allowances mapping in allowance.
Recipient and amount parameters flow into the transfer entry point.
Local msgSender value is assigned into _owner during construction.
Sender, recipient and amount parameters drive balance arithmetic in _transfer.
New owner address parameter is validated and written to _owner.
transfer delegates to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to internal _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_approve writes the new allowance value into _allowances.
_transfer subtracts from sender and adds to recipient _balances entries.
_transfer reads _tUniswapPair to evaluate the max wallet gate.
_transfer reads _tBlackAddress to bypass the max wallet restriction.
_transfer compares the transfer amount with _maxWallet.
setUniswapPair overwrites the Uniswap pair state variable.
setBlackAddress overwrites the blacklist state variable.
setFeeTotal increases total supply, enabling arbitrary inflation by the owner.
setFeeTotal mints new tokens directly to the owner balance.
setMaxWallet overwrites the transfer limit state variable.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
onlyOwner compares _owner against the caller for authorization.
onlyOwner obtains the caller identity via _msgSender.
renounceOwnership emits an event about _owner without actually clearing it.
transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
msg.sender is the origin of the identity returned by _msgSender.
Caller identity influences the minting recipient inside setFeeTotal.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setUniswapPair is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBlackAddress is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setFeeTotal is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxWallet is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
sendValue performs an external low-level call transferring control to recipient.
_functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary external call with value.
setFeeTotal drives the uncapped minting unsafe operation.
_transfer drives the balance arithmetic unsafe operation.
External call reached from Address library can reenter token transfer logic.

normalization_plan.reason: Setter parameter only exists to be assigned to _tUniswapPair by this function.
Setter parameter is only consumed by setBlackAddress.
Amount value is only used within the setFeeTotal mint logic.
Percentage value is only used inside setMaxWallet arithmetic.
Spender argument flows only into approve's allowance update.
Lookup keys are used only for reading _allowances in allowance.
Arguments are only consumed by the transfer entry point.
Cached deployer address is only used during construction to seed _owner.
Transfer arguments are only interpreted inside _transfer.
New owner argument is only validated and stored in transferOwnership.
